prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: four-frame animation sprite sheet for a Japanese elementary arithmetic-vocabulary web app. Create a crisp new high-resolution 1536 x 1024 image, split into exactly four equal 3:2 landscape panels in a 2 by 2 grid. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
Input image 1 is a REFERENCE for the two character identities and ONLY the THIRD ROW action (balloon bursting). Input image 2 is a REFERENCE ONLY for the crisp outline, smooth colors, high-resolution finish and consistent character design; do not repeat the pushing action.
White background, friendly textbook cartoon illustration. Same two black-haired boys throughout: orange long-sleeve shirt boy LEFT facing left, teal green shirt boy RIGHT facing left, both navy trousers and charcoal sneakers. Whole figures and the entire balloon fit in every panel. Orange torso at about 30% panel width, green torso at about80%; feet near92% panel height. Lock camera, scale, faces, clothing and ground line across all four frames.
A single red balloon stands on a very short safe headband/support on top of the LEFT orange boy's head, matching the original reference. The right green boy gently uses the edge of an open hand to burst the BALLOON. His hand acts on the balloon only, well above the head; no hitting a person's body, face or head. Both boys remain cheerful and unharmed.
Frame1: red balloon whole, right boy's open hand raised ready to the right of balloon, a clear air gap.
Frame2: right boy reaches toward the balloon, hand much nearer, balloon still fully intact.
Frame3: balloon visibly bursts into a few soft red rubber cartoon pieces floating in air; right boy's hand is at the former balloon surface; left boy has a cheerful surprised expression; no whole balloon remains.
Frame4: balloon gone, only short red tied balloon stub remains above headband, right boy lowers his hand back, both smiling. No balloon reinflation.
Keep the left/receiver and right/actor positions constant. Do not swap characters. No text, captions, numbers, arrows, speech bubbles, backgrounds, added people, sharp objects, weapons, or injury. Exactly one thin medium-gray vertical divider at the image center and one thin medium-gray horizontal divider at the center, no gutters or inset frames. Produce genuine crisp newly drawn art rather than enlarging the blurry old image.
